featured_reviews.review_text:
⚠️ Important Warning Before Buying from Eureka Forbes! ⚠️

Hello everyone,
Please think twice before purchasing any product from Eureka Forbes. Their service is absolutely the worst I’ve ever experienced.

I had registered a complaint, but they came to check the machine only after almost a month, that too after I kept calling and reminding them every single day. When they finally came, they took my machine away for 7–8 days, saying a part was damaged and needed replacement. Then again, it took another 8 days to get it back.

When they returned the machine, they did not give me my original product parts or the bill. They simply demanded payment on the spot, saying, “Pay this amount or you won’t get your machine back.”

When I asked for the replaced parts and the bill, they claimed it had a few months of warranty—but guess what? The machine stopped working again after just one month! And now the same issue and delay are repeating.

Honestly, Eureka Forbes has the worst service, zero responsibility, and no customer support.
Please don’t waste your money buying any product from them.
Worst experience ever!
